diffs.before: In those days I will open the storehouses of blessing in heaven, to send them down to the earth upon the work and toil of humankind.
diffs.after: In those days I will open the storehouses of blessing in heaven[a], to send them down to the earth upon the work and toil of humankind[b].

diffs.before: Peace and uprightness will be companions through all the days of eternity and all the generations of eternity.
diffs.after: Peace and uprightness[a] will be companions through all the days of eternity and all the generations of eternity[b].

diffs.before: Before these matters, Enoch had been hidden. No human being knew where he had been hidden, where he was, or what had happened.
diffs.after: Before these matters, Enoch had been hidden[a]. No human being knew where he had been hidden, where he was, or what had happened.

diffs.before: All his work was with the Watchers, and his days were with the holy ones.
diffs.after: All his work[a] was with the Watchers[b], and his days were with the holy ones.

diffs.before: I, Enoch, was blessing the Lord of majesty and the King of eternity. Then the Watchers called to me, Enoch the scribe, and said to me:
diffs.after: I, Enoch, was blessing the Lord of majesty[a] and the King of eternity. Then the Watchers called to me, Enoch the scribe[b], and said to me:

diffs.before: Enoch, scribe of righteousness, go and make this known to the Watchers of heaven. They left the high heaven, the holy dwelling place of eternity, corrupted themselves with women, acted as human children do, took wives for themselves, and wrought great corruption on the earth.
diffs.after: Enoch, scribe of righteousness, go and make this known[a] to the Watchers of heaven. They left the high heaven, the holy dwelling place of eternity, corrupted themselves with women, acted as human children do, took wives for themselves, and wrought great corruption[b] on the earth.

diffs.before: They will have neither peace nor forgiveness of sins.
diffs.after: They will have neither peace nor forgiveness of sins[a].

diffs.before: And because they delight in their children, they will see their loved ones killed. They will cry out over the loss of their children and plead forever, but they will have neither mercy nor peace.
diffs.after: And because they delight in their children[a], they will see their loved ones killed. They will cry out over the loss of their children and plead forever, but they will have neither mercy[b] nor peace.

insertions.after_exact_phrase: And because they delight in their children
